headline: Strategic Fronts Flash From Berm to Expanse
war_summary: Since the last edition, Palantine Berm has grown more violent and more fluid: four Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base are now reported, with ten events in the latest two hours and twenty-seven across the day. Marban Hollow has likewise shifted to four Colonial, three Warden, and one neutral base, recording four recent events amid heavy losses. Linn Mercy is another active sector, its nine Colonial and two Warden bases accompanied by four events in two hours and sharply accelerating casualties. Nevish Line now stands at seven Warden and one Colonial base, with three recent events and more than four thousand casualties reported over six hours. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s busiest ledger by the day, with sixty-three events, though its immediate two-hour window is quiet; seven Warden and two neutral bases remain. Mooring County has also fallen silent in the latest two hours after six events in six hours, while Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle show combat but less immediate base movement. The front is concentrated, not universal.
